evals.name: eval-full-run
evals.prompt: Run the system-eval workflow end-to-end against the real eval harness (7 records, most ungraded and unasserted).
evals.expected_output: All 6 steps execute. Ungraded records get grades. Assertions written to structural blocks. Scores computed. Analysis report written. Dashboard regenerated. state.yaml complete. Summary delivered.

assertions.description: All six steps are recorded in the transcript
At least one grade was assigned to a previously-ungraded record
Structural assertions were run and results written
score_eval.py ran and produced a batch average
An analysis report was written to systems/eval-harness/grading/
Dashboard HTML was regenerated
state.yaml ends as complete
Final summary delivered with record counts
Workflow opened and closed its own self-tracking eval record

evals.name: eval-early-exit
evals.prompt: Simulate fully-assessed state and verify the workflow skips Steps 2-4 and jumps directly to analyze and dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Step 1 detects early-exit condition. Steps 2 and 3 skipped. Steps 5 and 6 run. state.yaml complete.

assertions.description: Step 1 correctly detected early-exit condition
Steps 2 and 3 were not executed
Step 5 (analyze) ran and produced a report
Step 6 (dashboard) ran and regenerated dashboard
Step 4 (score) skipped in early-exit — design gap flagged
Test-injected data was restored to original state

evals.name: eval-partial-state
evals.prompt: Write an in-progress state.yaml pointing to step-03-grade and verify the workflow resumes there, skipping Steps 1 and 2.
evals.expected_output: STATE CHECK detects in-progress. Resume message surfaced. Steps 1-2 skipped. Steps 3-6 complete. state.yaml reset.

assertions.description: STATE CHECK correctly detected status: in-progress
Resume message correctly surfaced
Steps 1 and 2 not executed
Steps 3 through 6 all completed
Step 3 used needs_grade from accumulated-context
state.yaml reset to not-started at end
Concurrent run conflict identified and documented
